subject: Vendr profile: scope ownership, ephemeral access & evidence retention
messages:
From: Rahul Menon <rahul@brightleaf.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendr profile: scope ownership, ephemeral access & evidence retention

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking this on — Brightleaf is preparing our Vendr security profile and we want to streamline the upload and TTL expectations so it doesn't bounce between teams. We completed the first-pass SIG/CAIQ and have a short answers workbook attached (brightleaf_sig_answers_v1.xlsx).

Two asks from our side:
- Can you confirm who at Redwood will be the profile owner inside Vendr (field-level ownership for SIG/CAIQ)? We typically need a single contact for portal notifications and an escalation owner for evidence queries.
- For evidence uploads (SOC 2, encryption docs, key inventory), does Redwood accept
  a) direct vendor uploads via Vendr (preferred), or
  b) pre-signed S3 uploads (we can generate presigned URLs), or
  c) delegated upload via your security team if we provide links?

Also: what is Redwood's evidence retention TTL expected in Vendr? Our security team prefers 12–18 months for signed artifacts but we can stage a shorter window if you require ephemeral access.

Quick context: we will be providing a redacted SOC 2 Type II and specific KMS key rotation docs. If possible, we'd like to avoid repeated manual uploads.

Can we set a 30-minute sync next week to confirm mapping and ownership?

Thanks,
Rahul Menon
Head of Security Operations
Brightleaf, Inc.

Attachment: brightleaf_sig_answers_v1.xlsx (Excel workbook; 23kb)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Rahul Menon <rahul@brightleaf.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr profile: scope ownership, ephemeral access & evidence retention

Hi Rahul — thanks for the workbook, looked useful on first pass. A few quick proposals from our side and an initial action list so we can avoid the \"who-uploads-what\" ping-pong: 

Ownership proposal
- Portal notifications / profile owner: Olga Petrov (security contact) — olga.petrov@redwood.com
- Evidence triage / field mapping (SIG/CAIQ -> Redwood canonical fields): Karthik Iyer (platform security engineer) — karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Upload options & recommended approach
- Preferred: vendor uploads directly into Vendr. That keeps provenance and timestamps intact.
- If direct upload is not possible for some artifacts: presigned S3 uploads are fine. Our security policy sets default presign TTL to 24 hours for onboarding drops. If you need a longer window we can accept a one-time 72-hour presign on a per-artifact basis (requires an approval ticket).
- We do not support delegated long-term upload by external third parties; short-lived delegated links using our service account may be used for last-mile handoff during onboarding.

Evidence TTL & retention
- Recommended retention in Vendr: 12 months for transient artifacts (temp proof, screenshots), 24 months for signed reports (SOC 2). We can annotate fields with expected TTLs in the "vendr_access_matrix.csv" I attached.

Action items
1) Rahul: confirm which artifacts will be direct Vendr uploads vs presigned S3.
2) Karthik & Olga: accept owner roles in Vendr and we will create the profile and invite Rahul as a collaborator for uploads.
3) Rahul: if you want presigned URLs longer than 24 hours, provide justification and target artifacts; we'll route for approval.

I attached a lightweight access/field mapping CSV to reduce back-and-forth: vendr_access_matrix.csv.

If that looks good I'll set up the Vendr profile and send an invite to the Brightleaf security mailbox. If you prefer, we can run a 30-minute mapping workshop (recommended) — my calendar is open Thursday afternoon PST.

—
Mina Haddad
Manager, Security Intake & Portal Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Attachment: vendr_access_matrix.csv (CSV; 2kb)

From: Rahul Menon <rahul@brightleaf.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-13T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr profile: scope ownership, ephemeral access & evidence retention

Thanks Mina — that plan sounds good. Quick answers inline to keep the thread tidy:

- Upload plan:
  • SOC 2 (redacted PDF, signed): direct Vendr upload (preferred).
  • KMS rotation artifacts and key manifests: presigned S3 (we have several binary exports >10MB).
  • CAIQ appendix (spreadsheet): direct upload.

- Presign TTL: we can do 24 hours for most files but for the KMS exports we may need 72 hours once during the initial bulk upload — acceptable per your note; request included here.

- Delegated signer: we will not rely on delegated long-term upload. We simply asked if Redwood's security team could briefly accept a small number of files (one-time) if direct routes fail — sounds like you support short-lived service account links which is perfect.

Do you need a copy of our bridge-ticket for SOC 2 redaction (internal change log) or will the Vendr metadata be sufficient?

If Thursday afternoon PST is still available, let's take the workshop — 30 minutes to map fields and confirm owners. I'm available 14:00–16:00 PST.

Rahul,

Great — workshop confirmed. I've scheduled a 30-minute session for Thursday, 2026-06-17 at 14:30 PST and sent a calendar invite to the Brightleaf security mailbox. Agenda: 1) confirm Vendr profile owner/roles, 2) walk the vendr_access_matrix.csv and map principal fields, 3) finalize upload plan per artifact (direct vs presign).

Next steps (summary):
- Olga to create the Vendr profile and add Rahul/security@brightleaf.io as collaborator (by EOD tomorrow).
- Karthik will prepare the canonical field map and note TTLs in Vendr (24h presign default; 72h exceptions flagged).
- Rahul: bring final SOC 2 redacted PDF and KMS exports to the workshop; we'll test a presign flow with a single 72-hour object during the meeting.

If anything changes before the workshop, reply-all and we'll adapt. Looking forward to getting Brightleaf into Vendr.

—
Mina Haddad
Manager, Security Intake & Portal Onboarding
Redwood Inference
